Viewport shells match actual child/context/completion geometry in comfortable density and restore balanced density without overlap.
Collapsed Pinned sessions retains busy/question summary.

Question reply transitions to native permission with mark and collapsed summary retained.
Permission reply clears attention and busy labels without clearing completion.
Settled children disappear from the live count and disclosure; their terminal error remains discoverable on the parent's status and group summary.

checks: Active heading and creation share one row.

limitations: Visual fixture only: public-read inputs for activity, attention and ages are synthetic; nativeExecutionValidated is false.

The host owns terminal cell geometry, native Context/LSP/onboarding panels, theme and client font selection.
